title: Magical Drop III: Toretate Zoukangou! (Demo)
native_title: マジカル・ドロップⅢ ～とれたて増刊号！～
overview:
- Story Mode: fun with a story
- Endless Mode: play to your heart's content
- Versus Mode: battle with everyone
- Sugoroku Mode: roll the dice

Once a year, Magical Land holds a tournament whose winner receives the legendary Magical Drop, said to make dreams come true.

Magical Drop III is a fast-paced action puzzle game. Columns of colored drops push down from the top of your field while your jester at the bottom grabs drops and throws them back up. Line up three or more of the same color vertically to clear them, and set off chain reactions to send extra rows into your rival's field. Win by overflowing your opponent or by reaching your quota of cleared drops first. You can also push in a new row yourself to set up bigger combos.

This disc is a demo version of the game.

- 1-2 players
- Board game style Sugoroku Mode
